Hi David — thanks for sending the spreadsheet. We're aligning internal SMEs and I'll provide a consolidated response plus the supporting artifacts you asked for (schema + sample export template). Summary answers below; attached is an initial artifact set and a filled worksheet for your RFP. Full details are below the summary.

Summary (top-level):
- Event coverage: Our audit stream captures authentication events, API request/response metadata, admin actions (role changes, policy edits), model deployment/version rollouts, routing decisions (fallbacks, region switches), and rate-limit events.
- Retention: Default retention in Redwood Hosted is 180 days for audit events; Dedicated/Private customers can set custom retention down to 30 days or up to 7 years depending on contract and storage-tiering.
- Export: Exports are available as newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) or compressed CSV. For Hosted customers we provide an on-demand bulk export job that materializes to a customer-owned S3 bucket (or signed HTTPS URL) — typical completion for 90-day export is 30–90 minutes depending on token volume. For Dedicated/Private we support streaming export and direct filesystem export with lower latency.
- PII controls: Exports can be configured to include or redact request/response bodies. Raw tokenized payloads are treated as sensitive by default and excluded from exports unless explicitly enabled via a controlled export workflow with an auditable justification (and additional contractual safeguards).
- Export contents: Exports include full event metadata (timestamp, actor, request id, model id, route, status codes, cost tokens), and optionally the request/response payloads and inference outputs when enabled.

Neha/David — quick technical clarifications to add to the RFP response:

- Retention mechanics: For Hosted customers we implement retention via tiered cold storage. Data older than the configured hot window is moved to encrypted cold storage; metadata indices remain searchable for a configurable window. This allows retention up to 7 years with cost-optimized storage classes.
- Export pipeline: Bulk export jobs run as isolated, read-only workers with RBAC-limited credentials; the job writes directly to the customer-owned S3 prefix using temporary STS credentials. We sign and rotate credentials per export job and emit an export-job audit event with job id, requester, and output manifest URL.
- Redaction: We provide a configurable export policy object (json) where customers can declare fields to redact (PII, full_text, tokens). When raw payload export is enabled for compliance, exports are gated by an approval flow (token-based approval) that is recorded in the audit trail.

Small note for procurement: if you need SLA commitments on export completion time or a dedicated export throughput we can include a capacity carve-out in Dedicated contracts.
